name: Does cove molding installation require any special preparation before the team arrives?

mainEntity.name: Does cove molding installation require any special preparation before the team arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team arrives for cove molding installation, it's helpful if you clear the work area by moving furniture away from the walls and removing any wall hangings or fragile items. This ensures our installers have unobstructed access and reduces the risk of damage. While not strictly necessary, ensuring a clean and accessible perimeter can help the installation process proceed more smoothly and efficiently. We appreciate any steps you can take to prepare the space, which contributes to a quicker and more effective project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for cove molding installation by clearing furniture and wall hangings from the work area to ensure clear access for the team.
